notReadyRecord.rootCause: Interruption identity (interruptionEpisode) and the state point (stateAtBreak) are decided against the record's current supersession, the latest live report and its clock, not against the record as it stood on the break's first day. A report of an earlier break made after a later break began moves the latest report day past that later break, and it supersedes the report whose re-entry the athlete executed, so that report is no longer a starting point.

notReadyRecord.whyNotClosed: The author's tests, the self-challenge and P09 always made a same-break report before the next break began, and P09's returns always end the day before their report; the mutation check cannot measure a condition that is not written.
notReadyRecord.smallestArchitecturalDecision: Decide a report's break and its starting point from the record as it stood on the break's first day. (1) A report is the same break only when its stated days overlap or adjoin the days that break states, or when it begins before that break's first report (its re-entry); a break that begins after an earlier break's re-entry and after its days is a new break, whenever a later report of the earlier one was made. (2) The starting point is the return in force on the break's first day, even if a later report superseded it. Also for the Founder, from QE-R7A2-02 and SSCTR R37/NF-1: whether a late execution log of a break's week re-derives its return or prompts a same-break report, and whether a session on a break's stated first day is asked about.
